# onetsolutions_hosting_databases (Data Source)

Lists the MySQL databases of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_databases" "all" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "databases" {
  value = [for item in data.onetsolutions_hosting_databases.all.databases : item.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `databases` (Attributes List) The databases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--databases))

<a id="nestedatt--databases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `databases`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The full name of the database, prefixed with the web hosting's username.
- `size_mb` (Number) The disk space the database uses, in MB.
- `users` (List of String) The full usernames of the users with privileges on the database.
